items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 238:1
items.html: The head of AA, which is the stature of AB, is called the head of the thirteen corrections. And it alludes to the AB of the Mazal, that Bina returned to be Hochma by means of the MAN of the Dikna, and bestows Hochma to ZA. (Item 213).
